hypothesis: A monthly TN model can use the immutable state-consistent upper/lower water carrier without station history; a daily-compiled conservative tracer kernel may preserve information lost by direct monthly balance fractions.
forbidden: fixed T1, gamma TTD, SAS or a second groundwater store
TN refitting of any water parameter
carrier_decision: prefer DAILY_COMPILED_CARRIER only if all structural tests pass and temporal station/reach/tree plus nested LORO/LOTO are noninferior to MONTHLY_BALANCE_CARRIER at a 0.005 log-RMSE margin; otherwise lock MONTHLY_BALANCE_CARRIER
